from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A specific month's housing starts and completions data as reported in a release."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data refers to, in YYYY-MM format")
    starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total U.S. housing starts")
    completions_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total U.S. housing completions")

class ConstructionReport(BaseModel):
    """A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release containing housing construction data."""
    report_for_month: str | None = Field(description="The primary month this report covers, in YYYY-MM format")
    release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report was issued, in YYYY-MM-DD format")
    monthly_data: list[MonthlyDataPoint] = Field(description="List of monthly data points found in this report, including current month and historical revisions")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all construction reports extracted from the documents."""
    reports: list[ConstructionReport]
